The street at every hour and in every weather

WorldStreetApproved 2026-11-262 issues seen
Locks
The example street of real lots from World/ (building_kit_07): the café's awning and its lit windows, the facades' relief raked by the sun, the far rows closing it in haze; street lamps lit at dusk and on the lamp-lit night, dark on the moonlit nights; the full moon a cool light, a new moon only stars. Rain as the game's (Game/README Weather): thin pale streaks (4.5 mm), the open paving darker with a faint sheen in half-metre cells, soft-edged dark puddles with a little mirror and faint grey rings; none under a roof or arch. Snow lies only under open sky.
Approved
2026-11-26, the owner
Decision
the owner, 2026-11-26: "Street needs to have references for all 4 settings morning, mid day, dusk, and night"; rain as the game's ("Yes, both"); ADR-0061; the owner, 2026-11-26: "Approve, next place"; snow as small round balls, the near ones up to 30% smaller (the owner, 2026-11-26)

Market Square from its arcade at every hour and in every weather

WorldMarketSquareApproved 2026-11-263 issues seen
Locks

The sky and its clouds at every hour and in every weather

WorldSkyApproved 2026-11-262 issues seen
Locks
The sky over the town, seen from Market Square over the roofs: blue overhead fading to the pale haze at the horizon by day, warm towards the low sun at dusk, the night's dark blue with the town's glow low down; clouds as soft heaps on one layer about 1.2 km up, flat underneath and rounded on top, lit on the sun's side and shaded underneath, pink at dusk, lit from below by the town's lamps at night; how much of the sky they cover follows the weather (clear 0.36, cloudy 0.62, rain 0.97, fog 0.55, snow 0.92); at night the stars, the Milky Way and the full moon's disc. No planet (ADR-0064).
Approved
2026-11-26, the owner
Decision
the owner, 2026-11-26: "move to sky and cloud system"; ADR-0014 (the sky and clouds), ADR-0023 (the night sky), ADR-0064 (no planet); the owner, 2026-11-26: "leave the realistic clouds as they were", then "Approve, go to Market Square"; snow as small round balls, the near ones up to 30% smaller (the owner, 2026-11-26)

The old-town alley at every hour and in every weather

WorldAlleyApproved 2026-11-262 issues seen
Locks
The look of the world (the old-town alley of style test 02: matte mottled plaster and stone, soft rounded forms, W1-W8) at morning, midday and dusk; at night with the lamps on, and with them off under a full and a new moon; and by day in cloud, rain, fog and snow. No haze at midday. Rain and snow fall, puddles lie with rings where the drops fall into them, and the snow lies, only where the sky is open over them: never under the passage's roof. Only the light and the weather change between them. Rain as the game's (Game/README Weather): thin pale streaks (4.5 mm), the open paving darker with a faint sheen in half-metre cells, soft-edged dark puddles with a little mirror and faint grey rings; none under a roof or arch.
Approved
2026-11-26
Decision
the owner, 2026-11-26: "approved" (a reference shows every setting, not one; replaces WorldLook and the alley of WorldHours; ADR-0061); its rain redone as the game's (the owner, 2026-11-26: "Yes, both"; drops half as wide); snow as small round balls, the near ones up to 30% smaller (the owner, 2026-11-26)

A home's hallway by the stairs at every hour

IndoorHallwayApproved 2026-11-262 issues seen
Locks
A home's hallway (the owner, 2026-11-26: "corridor or near stairs area where there are no direct windows but indirect light coming from room"): a corridor about 1.7 m wide with no window of its own, the stair rising at its far end under a closed stairwell, the hall table, mirror, coat stand and rug along its left wall. By day its only light is the day coming through the open door of the room beside it, whose window faces the sun; at dusk and at night its pendant and the lamp on the hall table, the doorway dark; the full moon a dim, cool blue light from that doorway (the owner, 2026-11-26: as dim as the new moon was, and cooler), a new moon darker still, only the doorway faintly showing. In the world's light, lamps of their kinds (World/rules/lights.json).
Approved
2026-11-26, the owner
Decision
the owner, 2026-11-26: one home room and the hallway stand for the home's rooms ("just do one room, hall way, shop and cafe"); in the world's light; ADR-0061; the owner, 2026-11-26: "Approve it"

A home's room (the living room) at every hour

IndoorHomeRoomApproved 2026-11-263 issues seen
Locks
The living of furniture_kit_18, closed on four sides with one window. In the world's light (the owner, 2026-11-26: "use the same color etc from world lighting"): by day only the sun and sky of the hour, through the window, with the sunlit street outside throwing its light in; lamps and the fire out by day; the boards a greyer wood, so the bounced light is not orange; at night the lamps a warm white (until the kinds of light, FURN-066), the fire lit, the full moon a cool patch through the window, a new moon only the window's starlight. No weather settings indoors (the owner). The wall facing the people throws light back onto them (the owner, 2026-11-26: "the wall opposite to the character is not reflecting light back"): by day a little of the day through the window, at night a share of the lamps' light in their colour.
Approved

How the references are kept

  • Every approved look reference is in Art/Reference/<Category>/, named <Category><Subject>[_<Variant>].<ext> in PascalCase: Indoor/IndoorHomeRoom_Morning.jpg, Vehicles/VehiclesSoftBox.png. A reference's id is the name without the variant.
  • Art/Reference/catalog.json is the one list: what each locks, its approval and decision, the script that makes it, the game models built from it, issues seen, its old names. Agents read it there.
  • This page is written from it by python Tools/reference_catalog.py, which first checks that every file is listed and named by the rule. Never edit the page by hand.
  • A new reference: render it with its script, put it in its category's folder under its name, add it to the catalog, run the script. Changing the look needs a new ADR and the owner's approval (ADR-0004).
  • A reference taken out of use moves to Art/Retired/ and is listed under Retired.
  • Look tests and rejected ideas stay in Art/StyleTests/; they are not references.
